name: Gravity Failed Us
source:
Three days ago, you were a broke solo explorer on a cheap off-world expedition. 

Now, you're stranded on a restricted alien vessel with a cold, sharp-tongued scientist who keeps calling you an anomaly. He doesn’t rescue people. He observes them. 

But for some reason, he hasn’t cut you open yet.

[From [url=https://flaminglemon.itch.io/gravity-failed-us]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三天前，你是一名身无分文的独自探险家，正在进行一次廉价的外星探险。

现在，你被困在一艘受限制的外星飞船上，身边有一位冷酷、尖刻的科学家，他一直称你为异常现象。他不救人。他观察他们。

但出于某种原因，他还没有把你切开。

[来自[url=https://flaminglemon.itch.io/gravity-failed-us]itch.io[/url]]
